t: When something happens that you cannot make sense of
a: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
p: Mā aṣāba min muṣībatin illā bi-idhni-llāh, wa man yu'min billāhi yahdi qalbah…
m: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
